recommendation: Keep the no-change audit. Revisit only if FHIR-I opens a new tracker that supersedes the version-specific URL guidance or requests more precise package resolver wording beyond FHIR-35780.
issue_request: FHIR-35780 asked to update the version-specific profile guidance so Resource.meta.profile would use the StructureDefinition canonical URL plus a version, such as http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/Patient|4.0.1, instead of version-specific URLs such as http://hl7.org/fhir/3.0/StructureDefinition/Patient. The final Published/Not Persuasive with Modification resolution kept the version-specific canonicals and chose package-based resolvability instead.
initial_application: Git commit e93b4f3ecd8b2bfbfaf8996b19d5926cde408578 applied FHIR-35780 by adding a paragraph to source/versioning.html explaining that the http://hl7.org/fhir/{ver}/StructureDefinition/{type} pattern is not the normal StructureDefinition URL and pointing to the version-specific core package. The underlying Resource.meta.profile version-identification mechanism predates this issue and traces to FHIR-16165.
additional_context: The implementers Zulip R4B versioning thread shows the reporter raising the canonical-versus-version-specific-URL concern before filing FHIR-35779 and FHIR-35780. FHIR-I minutes from 2022-04-18 record the final decision: it was too late to change Transformer behavior, version-specific URLs are used by version-specific publishing packages, and the motion was Not Persuasive with Modification 8-0-0. Later FHIR-41622 corrected the package-id example on the same sentence to hl7.fhir.r{x}.core / hl7.fhir.r4.core and already has a separate combined-branch audit commit.
reconciliation: No source change was made. Current source/versioning.html still shows the version-specific profile example, explicitly notes that the URL pattern is not the normal StructureDefinition URL, and points to the corrected version-specific core package id. Replacing the example with canonical|version would contradict the accepted FHIR-I resolution.
